title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Reservation Terms and Conditions
content:
These are the conditions on which Ridgeline Tool Rental holds equipment booked ahead of pickup. The figures named below are the class figures of the reservation table.

1. **Booking horizon.** A reservation may be made no more than the class's booking horizon, in days, ahead of the pickup date.
2. **Reservation deposit.** When the class's reservation deposit is above 0.00, that deposit is collected as a reservation deposit when the reservation is made.
3. **Hold.** Reserved equipment is held for the class's hold hours after the booked pickup time, after which the system releases the reservation.
4. **Cancellation with notice.** A reservation cancelled at least the class's cancellation notice hours before the booked pickup time releases the reservation deposit in full. Notice is counted in full 60-minute periods back from the pickup time, and exactly that many hours qualifies.
5. **Late cancellation and no-show.** A later cancellation, or a no-show, forfeits the deposit where the class forfeits reservation deposits: the held deposit is applied to the agreement and a forfeited-reservation fee of an equal amount is billed. Where the class does not forfeit, the deposit is released.
6. **Deposit at checkout.** When the equipment is checked out, a reservation deposit is applied toward the rental charges at settlement, in the same way as the security deposit.

## Notice check (hypothetical aerial lift reservation, 24 hours' notice, 100.00 deposit, pickup Friday 09:00)

| Cancelled at | Full 60-minute periods before pickup | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| Thursday 08:30 | 24 | deposit released in full |
| Thursday 09:00 | 24 | deposit released in full (exactly 24 hours qualifies) |
| Thursday 09:20 | 23 | late cancellation: 100.00 applied and a 100.00 forfeited-reservation fee billed |
| no cancellation, no pickup within the hold | none | no-show: same as a late cancellation |

## Decision table for Clause 5

| Cancellation | Class forfeits reservation deposits | Deposit |
|---|---|---|
| with the required notice | either | released in full |
| late, or no-show | yes | applied, and an equal forfeited-reservation fee billed |
| late, or no-show | no | released |
